title: Sports Psychology
summary: Sports psychology: motivation, performance anxiety, team cohesion, mental preparation, focus, confidence, and psychological factors in athletic performance.
revision: Sports psychology: motivation, performance anxiety, team cohesion, mental preparation, focus, confidence.
traps: Sports psychology = psychological factors in sports/exercise.
Performance factors: motivation, anxiety, cohesion, preparation, focus.
Mental skills: visualization, goal-setting, relaxation, self-talk.

notes.t: The study of psychological factors affecting sports performance, athletic participation, and exercise behavior.

i: Motivation: intrinsic and extrinsic drive in sports
Team cohesion: unity and cooperation in teams
Focus and confidence: concentration and self-belief

notes.t: UGC NET may ask about sports psychology performance factors and mental skills.

mnemonics.title: MPTCF
mnemonics.text: M — Motivation (drive), P — Performance anxiety (competition stress), T — Team cohesion (unity), C — Confidence (self-belief), F — Focus (concentration)
